Armor Focus.descriptionOnly: no path: +1 to the armor bonus of the armor it picks, which its item holds

Armor Material Expertise.descriptionOnly: no path: its armor material's ability twice a day

Armor Trick.descriptionOnly: no path: the armor trick it picks is told by its option

Bulette Charge Style.descriptionOnly: no path: the +3 in medium armor and +2 in light armor of armor training are told here

Bulette Leap.descriptionOnly: no path: the –2 on each overrun after the first is taken at the table

Bulette Rampage.descriptionOnly: no path: damage on a successful overrun, rolled at the table

Feint Defender.descriptionOnly: no path: its shield's bonus to AC is added to the DC of feints against it, at the table

Guarded Charge.descriptionOnly: no path: its charge's AC, and +2 more with Improved Bull Rush or Overrun

Improved Armor Focus.descriptionOnly: no path: 1 less armor check penalty of the selected armor

Improved Shield Focus.descriptionOnly: no path: 1 less armor check penalty of its shield

Knocking Blows.descriptionOnly: no path: its –4 to CMD is the creature's it hits with Power Attack

Mobile Bulwark Style.descriptionOnly: no path: its tower shield's bonus to AC, enhancement included, on its CMD against bull rush and overrun, which the item holds

Mobile Fortress.descriptionOnly: no path: its tower shield's half bonus to touch AC

Mobile Stronghold.descriptionOnly: no path: no attack penalty for a tower shield's encumbrance, and cover in its style, at the table

Shield Brace.descriptionOnly: no path: the shield's armor check penalty, which its item holds, is on its attacks with the polearm or spear

Shield Gauntlet Style.descriptionOnly: only while its off hand holds nothing but the gauntlet

Shield Material Expertise.descriptionOnly: no path: twice a day by the shield's material, bleed of 1 + the shield's enhancement bonus, 10 less energy damage, or a sunder, at the table

Shield Material Mastery.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are another feature's, a form's, an action's or others', at the table

Shielded Gauntlet Attack.descriptionOnly: no path: its gauntlet deals a warpriest's sacred weapon damage at 4 less than its base attack bonus, and it has one more attack of opportunity a round, at the table

Shielded Gauntlet Master.descriptionOnly: no path: in the style its gauntlet's shield bonus is kept when it attacks and takes the gauntlet's enhancement bonus, which the item holds

Sprightly Armor.descriptionOnly: no path: its armor's enhancement bonus, which the item holds, is also on its initiative, at the table

Spring-Heeled Reaping.descriptionOnly: no path: two attacks at its full attack bonus during Shot on the Run or Spring Attack, at the table

Stumbling Bash.descriptionOnly: no path: its –2 to AC is the creature's its shield bash strikes

Swift Refuge.descriptionOnly: no path: once a day in the style (twice at base attack bonus +8, three times at +16), extra damage dice against it count as 1s, at the table

Toppling Bash.descriptionOnly: no path: its –5 is on the trip it attempts after a shield bash

Tower Shield Specialist.descriptionOnly: no path: a tower shield's armor check penalty is 3 less, which the shield item holds; with armor training a tower shield's penalty and max Dex change as armor's

Unhindering Shield.descriptionOnly: no path: a buckler's bonus to AC, which its item holds, is kept while its shield hand is busy

Upsetting Shield Style.descriptionOnly: no path: its –2 is on the attacks against it of the opponent its buckler bash damages

Upsetting Strike.descriptionOnly: no path: a foe under its style's attack penalty whose melee attack misses its AC by 5 or more provokes an attack of opportunity

Upsetting Vengeance.descriptionOnly: no path: the attack penalty is the foe's against any target, and its miss by 5 or more provokes an attack of opportunity

Vanguard Hustle.descriptionOnly: no path: half its shield's enhancement bonus goes to the shield bonus its Saving Shield gives an ally

Vanguard Style.descriptionOnly: no path: its +2 on Reflex saves is the adjacent ally's it aids

Vanguard Ward.descriptionOnly: no path: the shield bonus to AC it gives up is the ally's, at the table
